Instinct Instinct is a personal assistant that understands what you're working on and what's important to you. The interface is simple: there are no new interfaces. You can text or call it. It can use a phone and computer in the same way that humans do. It can help you dispute an unwarranted bill , send birthday gifts to friends , order groceries , schedule doctor's appointments , or plan a weekend getaway .
